note: The private half of tests/data/last_side_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the last side standing of the original's game (rules number 8) for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): the end rule (when it holds: the sides, one team, what counts as food and what does not), how the results rank (the highest score wins even with no ant; only a tie for the top goes to the side left, on the screen and in the history; the clock and the original's rule rank as they were), the switch (the rule is not 187's, set_game_mode sets it back, the state hash does not carry it) against test_last_side (2.9.10), the rules numbers of a replay (the player's choice of rule from the head, what a build plays, what a match is recorded under, the head check and the refusal) against test_rules_last_side (2.29.2), the history's ranking against test_history_record, and its list of recordings that play against test_history_store. Run from the checkout with a configured build folder: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/last_side_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1. Every mutant must be caught.
